rows.name: unit
rows.reason: Local invariants need no service wait; small inputs keep the feedback loop immediate.

rows.name: crate
rows.reason: Allow public encoding and validation while exposing accidental broad fixtures.

rows.name: integration
rows.reason: Allow composition and fault histories without a real-service wait.
rows.scope: one pure or mock integration test

rows.name: conformance
rows.reason: The same predicate needs a small bounded history on every implementation.
rows.scope: one pure or mock shared-contract case

rows.name: property
rows.reason: Bound construction and evaluation by declared sizes; shrinking is included in the campaign below.

rows.name: real-case
rows.reason: Allow actual transactions, RPC and controlled settlement while exposing unnecessary sleeps.

rows.name: pure-suite
rows.reason: A bounded selection of cases should stay interactive; this also covers bounded property generation and shrinking.
rows.scope: one named pure suite or level group

rows.name: mock-suite
rows.reason: Permit model histories and controlled fault schedules without paying service startup cost.

rows.name: postgresql-suite
rows.reason: Reserve time for isolated history, concurrency and restart cases on a provisioned instance.

rows.name: elements-suite
rows.reason: Allow signed blocks, depth, forks and recovery; measure controllable settlement rather than arbitrary sleep.

rows.name: combined-suite
rows.reason: Allow the combined durable and chain recovery path without hiding the cost in fast tests.
rows.scope: one PostgreSQL and Elements end-to-end suite

rows.name: test-command
rows.reason: The measured quiet test step is about [[quiet_tests]] seconds; keep a small margin and investigate growth.
rows.scope: the per-change pure and mock test command

rows.name: ordinary-check
rows.reason: Make repeated repository checks interactive; retained full-corpus work needs explicit registry review.

rows.name: benchmark
rows.reason: Allow warmup and multiple samples with deterministic work counts; larger campaigns need registry admission.

rows.name: clean-build
rows.reason: A [[budget_ms]]-millisecond initial allowance permits dependency compilation; it is a target awaiting a controlled cold measurement, not an observed result.
rows.scope: clean workspace dev or test build

rows.name: incremental-build
rows.reason: An ordinary implementation-file edit should preserve a short feedback loop; profile and dependency fan-out are diagnosed separately.
